method: Whole-set verification through git blob SHA1 from one recursive tree of the final mirror commit, plus real body re-reads for a deterministic sample. A git blob SHA1 hashes the exact stored bytes, so an equal SHA is an equal byte string.
raw_parquet_policy: Append-only on the host; only path, length and SHA256 published. Bodies were not uploaded or normalised.
ordering_note: Written after the mirror completed. No mirrored file hashes this readback.
